sections.title: Reading & Listening — In the Public Eye

exercises.instructionEn: In the Public Eye — read the article about the Backstreet Boys.
exercises.instructionUz: Xalq nazarida — Backstreet Boys haqidagi maqolani o'qing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SARLAVHA: 'In the Public Eye'
  = xalq nazarida, hammaning ko'z o'ngida.
  Mashhur odamlar haqida ishlatiladigan ibora.

TO'LIQ MATN:

  They are young, talented and famous. They are the
  Backstreet Boys, or BSB FOR SHORT, an ALL-BOY BAND from
  America.

  The band started with Howie Dorough, AJ McLean and Nick
  Carter.

  AJ worked as a model when he was six. He also acted in
  school PLAYS. When he was fourteen, he got to know Howie.
  Howie had ROLES in films and plays. They became friends
  and went to AUDITIONS together. They met Nick at one of
  those auditions. Nick's parents had a disco and Nick used
  to dance there. The three of them started singing
  together for a RECORD COMPANY called Transcontinental
  Records.

  The record company OWNER, Lou Perlman, had a friend who
  knew Kevin Richardson. Kevin had a job at Disney World in
  Orlando at the time. When Lou's friend told Kevin about
  the new group, Kevin decided to meet them. The four
  became friends and Kevin JOINED THE GROUP. Lou wanted one
  more person for the group. The fifth member was Brian
  Littrell, Kevin's cousin.

  BSB released their first album in 1996. They received
  their first GOLD RECORD in Germany for this album. A
  second album followed in late 1997.

  BSB have got FANS in many countries. Do you want to write
  to them? Their address is: Backstreet Boys, Post Office
  Box 618203, Orlando, FL 32861-8203.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:

  Ular yosh, iqtidorli va mashhur. Ular — Backstreet Boys,
  qisqacha BSB, Amerikadan kelgan faqat o'g'il bolalardan
  iborat guruh.

  Guruh Xaui Doro, EY-Jey Maklin va Nik Karter bilan
  boshlangan.

  EY-Jey olti yoshida model bo'lib ishlagan. Shuningdek
  maktab spektakllarida rol o'ynagan. O'n to'rt yoshida
  Xaui bilan tanishgan. Xaui film va spektakllarda rollar
  o'ynagan edi. Ular do'stlashib, birga tinglovlarga
  borishgan. Nikni ana shu tinglovlarning birida
  uchratishgan. Nikning ota-onasining diskotekasi bor edi
  va Nik u yerda raqsga tushardi. Uchovi birgalikda
  Transcontinental Records nomli yozuv kompaniyasi uchun
  qo'shiq ayta boshladi.

  Yozuv kompaniyasining egasi Lu Perlmanning Kevin
  Richardsonni taniydigan do'sti bor edi. O'sha paytda
  Kevin Orlandodagi Disney Worldda ishlardi. Luning do'sti
  Kevinga yangi guruh haqida aytganda, Kevin ular bilan
  uchrashishga qaror qildi. To'rtovi do'stlashdi va Kevin
  guruhga qo'shildi. Lu guruhga yana bitta odam xohlardi.
  Beshinchi a'zo Kevinning amakivachchasi Brayan Littrell
  bo'ldi.

  BSB birinchi albomini 1996-yilda chiqardi. Shu albom
  uchun Germaniyada birinchi oltin plastinkasini oldi.
  Ikkinchi albom 1997-yil oxirida chiqdi.

  BSB ning ko'p mamlakatlarda muxlislari bor. Ularga xat
  yozmoqchimisiz? Manzillari: Backstreet Boys, Post Office
  Box 618203, Orlando, FL 32861-8203.


BESH A'ZO VA ULAR QANDAY QO'ShILGAN:
  1-3) Howie, AJ, Nick — guruhni BOSHLAGANLAR
  4)   Kevin Richardson — Lu ning do'sti orqali qo'shilgan
  5)   Brian Littrell — Kevinning AMAKIVACHCHASI

UNIT MAVZUSI BILAN BOG'LIQLIGI:
  Diana va Motsart kabi, BSB ham 'in the public eye' —
  xalq nazarida. Lekin bu yerda shuhratning YAXShI tomoni
  ko'rsatilgan: yosh, iqtidorli, muvaffaqiyatli.

points.en: They are young, talented and famous.
points.noteUz:
Uchta sifat 'and' bilan bog'langan.
'talented' = iqtidorli (73-betdagi 16-mashqda ham bor).

points.en: They are the Backstreet Boys, or BSB for short, an all-boy band from America.
points.uz: Ular — Backstreet Boys, qisqacha BSB, Amerikadan kelgan faqat o'g'il bolalardan iborat guruh.
points.noteUz:
'for short' = qisqacha.
'an all-boy band' = faqat o'g'il bolalardan iborat guruh.
Guruh nomi oldidan THE.

points.en: The band started with Howie Dorough, AJ McLean and Nick Carter.
points.uz: Guruh Xaui Doro, EY-Jey Maklin va Nik Karter bilan boshlangan.
points.noteUz:
'to start WITH somebody' = kimlar bilan boshlanmoq.
Dastlab guruhda UCH kishi bo'lgan, keyin Kevin va Brayan qo'shilgan.

points.en: AJ worked as a model when he was six. He also acted in school plays.
points.uz: EY-Jey olti yoshida model bo'lib ishlagan. Shuningdek maktab spektakllarida rol o'ynagan.
points.noteUz:
'work AS' = ...bo'lib ishlamoq.
'a play' bu yerda = SPEKTAKL (o'yin emas).
'to act' = rol o'ynamoq.

points.en: When he was fourteen, he got to know Howie.
points.uz: O'n to'rt yoshida Xaui bilan tanishgan.
points.noteUz:
'get to know somebody' = kimdir bilan tanishmoq.
get → GOT (noto'g'ri fe'l).

points.en: Howie had roles in films and plays. They became friends and went to auditions together.
points.uz: Xaui film va spektakllarda rollar o'ynagan edi. Ular do'stlashib, birga tinglovlarga borishgan.
points.noteUz:
'a role' = rol.
'become' → BECAME;  'go' → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'llar).
'an audition' = tinglov, sinov (aktyor/qo'shiqchi tanlovi).

points.en: They met Nick at one of those auditions.
points.uz: Nikni ana shu tinglovlarning birida uchratishgan.
points.noteUz:
meet → MET (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'one of those ...' = ularning biri.

points.en: Nick's parents had a disco and Nick used to dance there.
points.uz: Nikning ota-onasining diskotekasi bor edi va Nik u yerda raqsga tushardi.
points.noteUz:
'used to + fe'l' = ilgari ...qilardi (endi qilmaydi).
O'tmishdagi ODAT haqida.
DIQQAT: 17c-mashqning 3-savoli shu gapga asoslanadi —
'a theatre' emas, 'a DISCO'.

points.en: The three of them started singing together for a record company called Transcontinental Records.
points.uz: Uchovi Transcontinental Records nomli yozuv kompaniyasi uchun birgalikda qo'shiq ayta boshladi.
points.noteUz:
'the three of them' = uchovi.
'a record company' = yozuv kompaniyasi.
'called ...' = ...deb ataladigan.

points.en: The record company owner, Lou Perlman, had a friend who knew Kevin Richardson.
points.uz: Yozuv kompaniyasining egasi Lu Perlmanning Kevin Richardsonni taniydigan do'sti bor edi.
points.noteUz:
'an owner' = ega, xo'jayin ('to own' = egalik qilmoq).
'who' — odam haqida ergash gap boshlaydi.
know → KNEW (noto'g'ri fe'l), 'k' o'qilmaydi.

points.en: Kevin had a job at Disney World in Orlando at the time.
points.uz: O'sha paytda Kevin Orlandodagi Disney Worldda ishlardi.
points.noteUz:
'at the time' = o'sha paytda.
17c-mashqning 4-savoli shu gapga asoslanadi —
Fransiya emas, ORLANDO (AQSh, Florida).

points.en: When Lou's friend told Kevin about the new group, Kevin decided to meet them.
points.uz: Luning do'sti Kevinga yangi guruh haqida aytganda, Kevin ular bilan uchrashishga qaror qildi.
points.noteUz:
tell → TOLD (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'tell somebody ABOUT something' — predlog ABOUT.
'decide TO + fe'l' = ...qilishga qaror qilmoq.

points.en: The four became friends and Kevin joined the group.
points.uz: To'rtovi do'stlashdi va Kevin guruhga qo'shildi.
points.noteUz:
'to join' = qo'shilmoq (to'g'ri fe'l: joined).
'the four' = to'rtovi.

points.en: Lou wanted one more person for the group.
points.uz: Lu guruhga yana bitta odam xohladi.
points.noteUz:
'one more' = yana bitta.
Shu sababdan beshinchi a'zo - Brayan Littrell qo'shilgan.

points.en: The fifth member was Brian Littrell, Kevin's cousin.
points.uz: Beshinchi a'zo Kevinning amakivachchasi Brayan Littrell bo'ldi.
points.noteUz:
'a member' = a'zo.
'a cousin' = amakivachcha, xolavachcha (barcha turi).
17c-mashqning 5-savoli shu gapga asoslanadi —
Kevin emas, BRIAN.

points.en: BSB released their first album in 1996.
points.noteUz:
'to release an album' = albom chiqarmoq.
17a-mashqning 3-savoliga javob.

points.en: They received their first gold record in Germany for this album.
points.uz: Shu albom uchun Germaniyada birinchi oltin plastinkasini oldi.
points.noteUz:
'a gold record' = oltin plastinka —
ko'p sotilgan albom uchun beriladigan mukofot.
17c-mashqning 6-savoli shu gapga asoslanadi —
Italiya emas, GERMANIYA.

points.en: A second album followed in late 1997.
points.noteUz:
'to follow' = ergashmoq, keyin kelmoq.
'in late 1997' = 1997-yil oxirida.
Aksi: 'in early 1997' = 1997-yil boshida.

points.en: BSB have got fans in many countries.
points.uz: BSB ning ko'p mamlakatlarda muxlislari bor.
points.noteUz:
'a fan' = muxlis.
DIQQAT: 'BSB HAVE got' — guruh nomi britanchada
KO'PLIK sifatida qaraladi (a'zolar ko'p).

points.en: Do you want to write to them? Their address is: Backstreet Boys, Post Office Box 618203, Orlando, FL 32861-8203.
points.uz: Ularga xat yozmoqchimisiz? Manzillari: Backstreet Boys, Post Office Box 618203, Orlando, FL 32861-8203.
points.noteUz:
'to write TO somebody' = kimgadir xat yozmoq - 'to' SHART.
'Post Office Box' (P.O. Box) = pochta qutisi.
FL = Florida shtatining qisqartmasi; 32861-8203 - pochta indeksi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the questions, then listen and answer them.
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarni o'qing, so'ng tinglab javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
Uchala savolning javobi MATNDA ham bor —
tinglashdan oldin o'qib topsa bo'ladi.

items.textEn: 1  Where are the Backstreet Boys from?
items.answer: They are from America. (Their address is in Orlando, Florida.)
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'an all-boy band FROM AMERICA'.
Manzillari ham Orlando, Florida (AQSh).
'Where ... FROM?' — 'from' gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

items.textEn: 2  How many are there in the band?
items.answer: There are five.
items.whyUz:
Howie, AJ, Nick (uchtasi boshlagan) + Kevin (4-si) +
Brian (5-si) = BESHTA.
Matnda: 'The FIFTH member was Brian Littrell'.
'How many ...?' — sanaladigan ot bilan.

items.textEn: 3  When did they release their first album?
items.answer: They released it in 1996.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'BSB released their first album IN 1996'.
Savolda 'did ... release' (asosiy shakl),
javobda 'released' (o'tgan shakl).

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text and explain the words in yellow.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing va sariq rangdagi so'zlarni tushuntiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N SARIQ IBORA:
  for short, an all-boy band, plays, roles, auditions,
  a record company, an owner, joined the group,
  a gold record, fans

Hammasi musiqa va shou-biznes lug'ati.

points.noteUz:
'the Backstreet Boys, or BSB FOR SHORT'
= qisqacha BSB.
Uzun nomning qisqa shaklini kiritish uchun.

'all-' = faqat ...dan iborat.
'a band' = musiqiy guruh.
Ayollar guruhi: 'an all-girl band'.

'He acted in school PLAYS.'
DIQQAT: 'a play' bu yerda SPEKTAKL, teatr asari.
'to play' (o'ynamoq) fe'li BILAN ADAShTIRMANG.
'a school play' = maktab spektakli.

'Howie had ROLES in films and plays.'
'a role' = rol (film yoki spektaklda).
'to play a role' = rol o'ynamoq.
'the main role' = bosh rol.

'They went to AUDITIONS together.'
'an audition' = aktyor yoki qo'shiqchi tanlanadigan sinov.
O'zbekchada 'kasting' ham deyiladi.
'to audition for a role' = rol uchun sinovdan o'tmoq.

'singing for a RECORD COMPANY'
Qo'shiqchilar bilan shartnoma tuzib, albom chiqaradigan firma.
'a record' = plastinka, yozuv.

'The record company OWNER, Lou Perlman'
'to own' = egalik qilmoq → 'an owner' = ega.
Shunga o'xshash: to work → a worker.

'Kevin JOINED THE GROUP.'
'to join' = qo'shilmoq, a'zo bo'lmoq.
TO'G'RI fe'l: join → joined.
DIQQAT: 'join TO the group' XATO — 'to' KERAK EMAS.

'They received their first GOLD RECORD in Germany.'
Ko'p sotilgan albom uchun beriladigan mukofot.
Undan ham yuqorisi: 'a platinum record'.

'BSB have got FANS in many countries.'
'a fan' = muxlis, ishqiboz.
'fanatic' so'zining qisqargan shakli.

exercises.instructionEn: Then underline all past simple forms.
exercises.instructionUz: So'ng barcha oddiy o'tgan zamon shakllarining tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
MATNDAGI BARCHA PAST SIMPLE SHAKLLARI
(matnda uchrash tartibida):

  TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (-ed):
     started, worked, acted, released, received,
     followed, joined, wanted, decided

  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
     was      (be)      — 'AJ ... when he WAS six'
     got      (get)     — 'he GOT to know Howie'
     had      (have)    — 'Howie HAD roles'
     became   (become)  — 'They BECAME friends'
     went     (go)      — 'WENT to auditions'
     met      (meet)    — 'They MET Nick'
     knew     (know)    — 'a friend who KNEW Kevin'
     told     (tell)    — 'Lou's friend TOLD Kevin'

  ALOHIDA HOLAT:
     used to dance — 'used to' o'tmishdagi ODATNI bildiradi

DIQQAT — 'STARTED' IKKI MARTA:
  'The band STARTED with Howie ...'
  'The three of them STARTED singing ...'

DIQQAT — 'HAD' UCH MARTA:
  'Howie HAD roles ...'
  'Nick's parents HAD a disco ...'
  'Lou Perlman HAD a friend ...'
  'Kevin HAD a job ...'  (to'rtinchi marta!)

points.noteUz:
TO'G'RI: start → started.
Matnda IKKI marta.
TO'G'RI: work → worked.
NOTO'G'RI: be → was.

TO'G'RI: act → acted.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').

NOTO'G'RI: get → got.
'got to know' = tanishdi.

NOTO'G'RI: have → had.
Matnda TO'RT marta.

NOTO'G'RI: become → became.
73-betdagi Spelling qutisida namuna sifatida berilgan.
NOTO'G'RI: go → went.

NOTO'G'RI: meet → met.
Ikkita 'e' bittaga tushadi.

'used to + fe'l' — o'tmishdagi ODAT.
Ma'nosi: ilgari qilardi, ENDI QILMAYDI.

NOTO'G'RI: know → knew.
DIQQAT: boshidagi 'k' O'QILMAYDI — /njuː/.

NOTO'G'RI: tell → told.
'tell somebody ABOUT something'.

TO'G'RI: decide → decided (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).
'decide TO + fe'l'.

TO'G'RI: join → joined.
'join the group' — 'to' KERAK EMAS.

TO'G'RI: want → wanted.
-ed /ɪd/ deb o'qiladi (oxiri 't').
TO'G'RI: release → released (oxiri 'e' → faqat + D).

TO'G'RI: receive → received.
Yozilishi: 'i' dan OLDIN 'e'.
TO'G'RI: follow → followed.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text again and correct the sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni yana o'qing va gaplarni to'g'rilang, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  AJ worked as a model when he was three.
     Wrong! AJ DIDN'T WORK as a model when he was three.
     He WORKED as a model when he was six.

QOLIP (IKKI GAP):
  Wrong! [ega] DIDN'T [ASOSIY fe'l] + noto'g'ri ma'lumot.
         [ega] [O'TGAN fe'l] + to'g'ri ma'lumot.

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT:
  1-gapda: DIDN'T + ASOSIY shakl  (didn't WORK)
  2-gapda: O'TGAN shakl           (WORKED)
  Bir javobda IKKI xil shakl ishlatiladi!

DIQQAT — 'BE' FE'LI BOSHQACHA:
  5-bandda 'was' bor — 'didn't' KERAK EMAS:
     The fifth member WASN'T Kevin.  ✓
     The fifth member DIDN'T BE ...  ✗ XATO

items.textEn: 1  AJ worked as a model when he was three.
items.answer: Wrong! AJ didn't work as a model when he was three. He worked as a model when he was six.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'AJ worked as a model when he was SIX'.
Inkorda 'didn't WORK' (asosiy shakl),
tasdiqda 'WORKED' (o'tgan shakl).

items.textEn: 2  AJ got to know Howie when he was thirteen.
items.answer: Wrong! AJ didn't get to know Howie when he was thirteen. He got to know him when he was fourteen.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'When he was FOURTEEN, he got to know Howie'.
DIQQAT: 'didn't GET' — asosiy shakl ('didn't got' XATO).
Tasdiqda 'GOT' (noto'g'ri fe'lning o'tgan shakli).

items.answer: Wrong! Nick's parents didn't have a theatre. They had a disco.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'Nick's parents had a DISCO'.
DIQQAT: 'didn't HAVE' — asosiy shakl ('didn't had' XATO).
Tasdiqda 'HAD'.

items.textEn: 4  Kevin had a job at Disney World in France.
items.answer: Wrong! Kevin didn't have a job at Disney World in France. He had a job at Disney World in Orlando.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'Kevin had a job at Disney World in ORLANDO'.
Orlando — AQSh, Florida shtati.
(Parijda ham Disneyland bor, lekin matnda Orlando aytilgan.)

items.answer: Wrong! The fifth member wasn't Kevin. It was Brian Littrell.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'The fifth member was BRIAN LITTRELL'.
DIQQAT — BU BAND BOSHQACHA:
'was' — 'to be' fe'li, shuning uchun 'didn't' KERAK EMAS.
Faqat 'WASN'T' yoziladi.
Kevin TO'RTINCHI a'zo edi.

items.textEn: 6  They received their first gold record in Italy.
items.answer: Wrong! They didn't receive their first gold record in Italy. They received it in Germany.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'They received their first gold record in GERMANY'.
'didn't RECEIVE' (asosiy shakl) →
'RECEIVED' (o'tgan shakl).
Ikkinchi gapda 'it' = 'their first gold record'.

exercises.instructionEn: Finally, in pairs, ask and answer questions about BSB using who/where/when/what.
exercises.instructionUz: Nihoyat, juftlikda who/where/when/what so'zlaridan foydalanib BSB haqida savol-javob qiling.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT SAVOL SO'ZI:
  WHO   = kim
  WHERE = qayerda
  WHEN  = qachon
  WHAT  = nima

SAVOL QOLIPI (past simple):
  [savol so'zi] + DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
     When DID they RELEASE their first album?

  'to be' bilan:
  [savol so'zi] + WAS/WERE + ega?
     Who WAS the fifth member?

DIQQAT — EGA SO'RALSA 'DID' KERAK EMAS:
  Who STARTED the band?     ✓  (who = ega)
  Who DID start the band?   ✗  (odatda ishlatilmaydi)

Hamma javob matnda bor.

items.question: Who started the band?
items.answer: Howie Dorough, AJ McLean and Nick Carter started the band.
items.whyUz:
'Who' EGA vazifasida → 'did' KERAK EMAS.
Matnda: 'The band started with Howie Dorough, AJ McLean
and Nick Carter'.

items.question: Who was the fifth member?
items.answer: The fifth member was Brian Littrell, Kevin's cousin.
items.whyUz:
'to be' bilan savol → 'did' KERAK EMAS.
'Who WAS ...?'

items.question: Where did Kevin work?
items.answer: He worked at Disney World in Orlando.
items.whyUz:
'Where DID ... WORK?' — 'did' + ASOSIY shakl.
Javobda 'worked' (o'tgan shakl).

items.question: Where did they receive their first gold record?
items.answer: They received it in Germany.
items.whyUz: 17c-mashqning 6-bandi bilan bir xil ma'lumot.

items.prompt: WHEN — EY-Jey Xaui bilan qachon tanishgan
items.question: When did AJ get to know Howie?
items.answer: He got to know him when he was fourteen.
items.whyUz:
'When DID ... GET?' — 'did' + ASOSIY shakl.
Javobda 'got' (noto'g'ri fe'lning o'tgan shakli).

items.question: When did BSB release their first album?
items.answer: They released it in 1996.
items.whyUz: 17a-mashqning 3-savoli bilan bir xil.

items.prompt: WHAT — Nikning ota-onasida nima bor edi
items.question: What did Nick's parents have?
items.answer: They had a disco.
items.whyUz:
'What DID ... HAVE?' — 'did' + ASOSIY shakl ('have').
Javobda 'had'.

items.prompt: WHAT — Xauida film va spektakllarda nima bor edi
items.question: What did Howie have in films and plays?
items.answer: He had roles in films and plays.
items.whyUz:
'a role' = rol.
Matnda: 'Howie had ROLES in films and plays'.

sections.title: Speaking — When was the last time you ...?

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts and the time expressions below and, in pairs, act out short dialogues, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ko'rsatmalar va vaqt iboralaridan foydalanib juftlikda qisqa dialoglar tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
SAVOL QOLIPI:
  WHEN WAS THE LAST TIME YOU ...?
  = Oxirgi marta qachon ...?

SAKKIZ KO'RSATMA:
  write a letter?          xat yozmoq
  visit your grandparents? bobo-buvingizni ko'rgani bormoq
  buy new clothes?         yangi kiyim sotib olmoq
  tidy your room?          xonangizni yig'ishtirmoq
  wash the car?            mashinani yuvmoq
  have a haircut?          soch oldirmoq
  get a present?           sovg'a olmoq
  have a party?            ziyofat qilmoq

VAQT IBORALARI:
  yesterday                       kecha
  yesterday morning/evening, etc  kecha ertalab/kechqurun
  two days/weeks, etc ago         ikki kun/hafta oldin
  last Monday/Tuesday, etc        o'tgan dushanba/seshanba
  a week/month, etc ago           bir hafta/oy oldin

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: When was the last time you wrote a letter?
  SB: The last time I wrote a letter was two days ago.
      How about you?
  SA: The last time I wrote a letter was a month ago.

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT — SAVOLDA VA JAVOBDA IKKALASIDA HAM
O'TGAN SHAKL:
  When was the last time you WROTE a letter?   ✓
  When was the last time you WRITE a letter?   ✗ XATO

  Sababi: bu yerda 'did' YO'Q — 'was' bor.
  Shuning uchun asosiy fe'l O'TGAN shaklda qoladi.
  Bu — 17c-mashqdagi 'didn't + asosiy shakl' dan FARQ QILADI.

JAVOB QOLIPI:
  The last time I [o'tgan fe'l] ... WAS [vaqt].

DIQQAT — 'AGO' DOIM OXIRIDA:
  two days AGO;  a month AGO.
  'ago before' XATO.

DIQQAT — 'HOW ABOUT YOU?':
  = Sen-chi?  Savolni qaytarish uchun.
  'What about you?' ham to'g'ri.

items.question: When was the last time you wrote a letter?
items.answer: The last time I wrote a letter was two days ago. How about you? — The last time I wrote a letter was a month ago.
items.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
write → WROTE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Savolda ham, javobda ham 'wrote' — o'tgan shakl.

items.question: When was the last time you visited your grandparents?
items.answer: The last time I visited my grandparents was last Sunday. How about you? — The last time I visited my grandparents was two weeks ago.
items.whyUz:
visit → visited (to'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: savolda 'YOUR grandparents',
javobda 'MY grandparents' — egalik olmoshi o'zgaradi.

items.question: When was the last time you bought new clothes?
items.answer: The last time I bought new clothes was a month ago. How about you? — The last time I bought new clothes was yesterday.
items.whyUz:
buy → BOUGHT (noto'g'ri fe'l), /bɔːt/.
'clothes' — DOIM ko'plikda ('a clothe' YO'Q).

items.question: When was the last time you tidied your room?
items.answer: The last time I tidied my room was yesterday morning. How about you? — The last time I tidied my room was last Monday.
items.whyUz:
tidy → TIDIED (undosh 'd' + 'y' → -IED).
73-betdagi 3-qoida.
'to tidy' = yig'ishtirmoq, tartibga solmoq.

items.question: When was the last time you washed the car?
items.answer: The last time I washed the car was two days ago. How about you? — The last time I washed the car was a week ago.
items.whyUz:
wash → washed (to'g'ri fe'l).
-ed /t/ deb o'qiladi.

items.question: When was the last time you had a haircut?
items.answer: The last time I had a haircut was three weeks ago. How about you? — The last time I had a haircut was last Tuesday.
items.whyUz:
have → HAD (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'a haircut' = soch olish;  'have a haircut' = soch oldirmoq.
hair + cut — qo'shma ot.

items.question: When was the last time you got a present?
items.answer: The last time I got a present was on my birthday. How about you? — The last time I got a present was two months ago.
items.whyUz:
get → GOT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'a present' = sovg'a.
'ON my birthday' — bayram kuni bilan ON.

items.question: When was the last time you had a party?
items.answer: The last time I had a party was last month. How about you? — The last time I had a party was a year ago.
items.whyUz:
have → HAD.
'have a party' = ziyofat qilmoq.
DIQQAT: 'LAST month' da 'ago' YO'Q —
'last' va 'ago' birga ishlatilmaydi:
  last month  ✓   /   a month ago  ✓
  last month ago  ✗ XATO

wordFormation.introUz: 74-bet — shou-biznes lug'ati, noto'g'ri fe'llar, vaqt iboralari.

groups.explanationUz: Bu matnda 8 ta noto'g'ri fe'l bor.

patterns.formula: WRONG! Ega + DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l + noto'g'ri ma'lumot. Ega + O'TGAN fe'l + to'g'ri ma'lumot.
patterns.exampleEn: Wrong! AJ didn't work as a model when he was three. He worked as a model when he was six.
patterns.exampleUz: Noto'g'ri! EY-Jey uch yoshida model bo'lib ishlamagan. U olti yoshida model bo'lib ishlagan.
patterns.explanationUz:
Bir javobda IKKI xil shakl:
inkorda ASOSIY, tasdiqda O'TGAN.

patterns.formula: Ega + WASN'T + ... . It WAS ... .   ('be' fe'li uchun)
patterns.exampleEn: The fifth member wasn't Kevin. It was Brian Littrell.
patterns.exampleUz: Beshinchi a'zo Kevin emas edi. U Brayan Littrell edi.

patterns.formula: WHEN WAS THE LAST TIME YOU + O'TGAN fe'l?
patterns.exampleEn: When was the last time you wrote a letter?
patterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta qachon xat yozgan eding?
patterns.explanationUz:
'did' YO'Q ('was' bor) → asosiy fe'l O'TGAN shaklda.
'you write' XATO — 'you WROTE'.

patterns.formula: The last time I + O'TGAN fe'l + ... WAS + vaqt ibora.
patterns.exampleEn: The last time I wrote a letter was two days ago.
patterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta ikki kun oldin xat yozgandim.

patterns.exampleEn: When he was fourteen, he got to know Howie.
patterns.exampleUz: O'n to'rt yoshida Xaui bilan tanishdi.
patterns.explanationUz: 'get to know somebody' = kimdir bilan tanishmoq.

patterns.formula: Ega + JOINED + guruh.   /   Ega + RELEASED + albom.
patterns.exampleEn: Kevin joined the group. BSB released their first album in 1996.
patterns.exampleUz: Kevin guruhga qo'shildi. BSB birinchi albomini 1996-yilda chiqardi.
